title: Southern Charm | Cozy 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stay at Southern Charm, a cozy beach house on 30A. Perfect for a relaxing and comfortable vacation.
description_expanded: Southern Charm Features - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Enjoy 3 Taxi Bikes, perfect for exploring WaterColor and 30A - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee/per pet is required prior to your arrival. - Designer interiors - Flexible Summer Stays available! Arrive any day and stays less than 7 nights available - subject to approval based on arrival date - 1 Minute bike ride to Camp WaterColor - Driveway Parking for 2 vehicles. Not recommended for oversized vehicles. Nearby neighborhood parking available on a first come, first serve basis for oversized vehicles. - All suite bedrooms including a 1st floor king suite - Steps to a large park at Camp WaterColor with a playground - perfect for picnics and playtime with the kids - Covered front porch with relaxing daybed swing and cafe dining table - Full kitchen with high end appliances and ample supply of kitchenware for your cooking needs - Spacious living room with TV - Dining for 11 - 1st floor laundry closet with washer and dryer - Entire 2nd floor is a kid's paradise with a private suite and flat screen TV - Enclosed outdoor shower next to back entrance of home - Outdoor grill - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all WaterColor community pools included with your reservation for 6 guests age 5 and older - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Come enjoy some Southern Charm! Our designer home is only a 2-minute stroll to Camp WaterColor and a 5-minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club. Southern Charm will make you feel right at home while you enjoy your wonderful WaterColor vacation. With all designer interiors, this renovated home combines comfort and chic style for a luxurious beach vacation. You will be ideally located next to the famed Camp WaterColor, where you can enjoy the lazy river, jumbo slides, lap pool, and zero entry kid's pool. Access is included with your reservation. The adjacent park is the perfect spot for a pickup soccer game, picnic, or a game of catch. And don't forget about the playground for the kids and young at heart! All suite bedrooms ensure your family has the personal space they need when it is time to rest. And the kids will go nuts for the top floor kids' suite, featuring two built in twin over full bunks and decor with kids in mind. Adults will enjoy the covered balcony with daybed swing and cafe table for morning coffee or evening cocktails. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

2nd Floor Kids Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in two twin over full built-in bunks, TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
